Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections III''' is the 31st Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 31 October 2001. It has 200 cards (100 per side): 100 foils and 100 non-foil premiums. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus three unique premiums (listed under Card list)[https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists], Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) and random reprints from Premiere through Endor. Those reprints are not listed. A foil of a title that is not on this list is not a Decipher Reflections III pack foil (it may be a [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]] or a counterfeit).[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2].
